## IMPULSE 1.0.1

A small polish release that keeps ordinary users on the public IMPULSE website instead of sending them to GitHub from the in-app About screen.

### Changed

- The About website entry now uses a cleaner two-line layout: `App website` / `Сайт приложения` with `stanleyll0yd.github.io` shown on the next line.
- Tapping the website entry opens the IMPULSE product page at `https://stanleyll0yd.github.io/apps/impulse/`.
- Added a dedicated Privacy policy / Политика конфиденциальности entry opening `https://stanleyll0yd.github.io/apps/impulse/privacy/`.
- No GitHub destination remains in the About screen.
- API 37 runtime coverage verifies both About links are present.

Gameplay, progression, achievements, replay modes, music, accessibility settings, and the fully offline architecture are unchanged.

Android version is now **1.0.1** with `versionCode 13`.
